d: Pauravraj apne putr malayketu ke sath chandragupt se milne aata hai, vahan use aachary vishnugupt bhi milte hain, vo vishnugupt ko batata hain ki kekaiy raj unki bhumi harapna chahte hain. aur vah chandragupt se aagrah karta hai ki uski bhumi dilane men vah uski madad kare badle men vah use dhan aur shastro se sahayta karega, magar chandragupt uski ye mang thukra deta hai aur asantusht pauravraj apne putr sahit vahan se chala jata hai - kya vah chandragupt ke viruddh koee shadyantr kar sakta hai? yadi han to- kya? dekhie is bhag men.
